Wish.title: Wish
Wish.description: Wedding wish, blessing, or private message sent by an invited guest to Adjie & Daulika.

sender_name.description: Display name of the guest sending the wish.

message.description: Body of the blessing or congratulatory message.

visibility.description: Whether the wish can be displayed publicly to other guests or kept private for the couple.

moderation_status.description: Moderation state controlled on creation (PUBLIC->APPROVED, PRIVATE->PENDING) and updatable by admin.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the wish was submitted.

moderatedAt.description: Server timestamp when an administrator last moderated the wish.

Rsvp.title: Rsvp
Rsvp.description: Attendance confirmation for a single invited guest under the strict 1-person policy.

guest_name.description: Name of the guest confirming attendance.

attending.description: True if the guest will attend; false if declined.

guest_count.description: Strict 1-person headcount: 1 when attending is true, 0 when attending is false.

rsvp_status.description: Canonical attendance status string matching the attending boolean.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the RSVP was first recorded.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the RSVP was last updated.

GuestOverride.title: GuestOverride
GuestOverride.description: Administrator override for a guest display name from the 153-entry invitation list.

guest_name.description: Updated display name used to generate the personal ?to= link.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last edit.

AdminRole.title: AdminRole
AdminRole.description: Read-only admin role marker managed exclusively via Firebase Console.

/wishes/{wishId}.description: Wedding wishes submitted by guests. PUBLIC + APPROVED wishes are publicly readable; PRIVATE and unapproved wishes are restricted to verified administrators.

/rsvps/{rsvpId}.description: Guest attendance confirmations keyed by high-entropy client capability IDs. Only verified administrators can read or list RSVPs.

/guest_overrides/{guestNo}.description: Administrator-managed display name overrides for the 153 guest entries.

/admins/{uid}.description: Admin role records; strictly non-writable from client SDKs.
